MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items felt like a natural next purchase for me right now.",
    "The USB-C cable came closest to my interest in practical accessories, but I have no current need for that connection or charging function."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Alexa speakers, displays, smart plug and car assistant do not solve the computer connectivity needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "The streaming sticks offer entertainment features I am not currently seeking, and buying a tablet mount does not mean I need a replacement tablet.",
    "Even a cable is only useful to me when its connectors and purpose match a specific need; the USB-C charging cable does not meet an identified need now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in particular electronic accessories seems to have been treated as interest in electronic devices generally.",
    "The list seems to assume that owning accessories means I want additional devices, when my purchases have mostly addressed specific practical problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My WiFi adapter, USB expansion card, DVI cable and Ethernet adapter point toward connecting existing equipment and adding useful ports or network access.",
    "Compatibility and the exact function matter more to me than a broad resemblance to something I bought before.",
    "My purchases are spread over years, so a past accessory purchase is not enough to make me want another item now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations picked up my interest in electronics but missed my selective focus on accessories that solve a specific connectivity need."
}
